description: rmHARD (HardAssetsVault) launch assets: PAXG (Paxos Gold) only, a plain basket row with no oracle, on its Aero (Aerodrome Slipstream) CL USDC pool, tick spacing 10, priced from the pool TWAP through the existing AerodromeSwapAdapter (ADR-0018, owner decision 2026-11-10). PAXG token from docs.paxos.com (Base Mainnet). Factory and router from dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public deployment-addresses/cl-base.json. Read from Base mainnet at block 55670968: the pool holds about 386k USDC and 127 PAXG, factory.getPool(USDC, PAXG, 10) returns the pool, observationCardinality is 900 (the vault needs 901, so increaseObservationCardinalityNext(901) must land before the deploy, docs/operations/contract-release-runbooks.md). No Uniswap V3 or V4 PAXG/USDC pool has depth.
